bullets.text: Photo estimating completed ~20% of estimates, returning them two days faster; August testing begins on machine learning algorithm for estimate workflows; claims texting exceeded 3M interactions; 11,000+ eSign forms completed.
Advanced from #4 to #3 in the private passenger auto marketplace; currently serves 19 million customers supported by nearly 36 thousand employees across the company.

YTD combined ratio was 89.7, aided by strong frequency trends, new application growth, and retention; over the past five years, comprehensive ROE averaged 18% and annual stock price appreciation averaged 25%.
YTD NPW increased approximately 21%, with 11% compounded annual growth over five years; TNC net premiums earned rose nearly 120% over Q1 following Uber footprint expansion into four states.

Quarterly catastrophe impacts totaled $125 million for vehicle businesses and $82 million for Property after reinsurance; companywide cat losses fell 12% YOY; leased Nashville claims handling facility is expected to open in August.

Rolled out HQX bundled auto-home quoting across all available states; Progressive Property added direct online buying in Wisconsin; Smart Haul UBI take rate is trending up with ELD mandate enforcement.

Portfolio total return was 0.6% in Q2 amid high market volatility; equities returned 3.1%; added to corporate bonds as valuations became more attractive; higher interest rates offer potential yield gains.

Comfortable with commercial auto rate levels; removed multiple underwriting restrictions early in Q2, though select truck underwriting restrictions remain active in California, Florida, and a few other markets.

Appointed Andrew Quigg as Chief Strategy Officer leading a dedicated team focused on Horizon 3 future business initiatives, following work initiated by the eleven-person Strategy Council formed in December 2017.
Marked the fifth anniversary of STEM Progress program; over 1,000 employee volunteers have taught 1,010 classes across 275 schools to 26,000 students in 31 states using insurance concepts.
